title.narrative: START Fund - Support to Cholera Response Malawi

description.narrative: Overall objective: Incidence of cholera is reduced in target populations; Ensure sufficient supply of safe drinking water; Ensure improved access to safe sanitation facilities ;Increase knowledge on disease transmission and prevention;Ensure adequate waste management.

The intervention aims at limiting morbidity and mortality due to cholera through sensitization measures coupled with inputs (safe water, sanitation, handwashing and others) to increase awareness on transmission factors and protective preventive measures. Leadership engagement from community to district-level will reinforce the sensitization messages. The intervention takes place in areas where the applying agency is well established with good links to both communities and district authorities and camp management which facilitates swift implementation. Activities in refugee settings will be implemented directly by WHH together with the affected population. Outside the camp setting activities will be implemented by district authorities under the guidance and with logistics and financial support from WHH.

The intervention aims to reach directly 17,414 households x 4.4 household size = reach: 75,414 individuals (51,5% females, 48.5% males).The interventions will reach indirectly approx. 124, 220 households x 4.4 household size = Reach: 546 570 people (51.5% females, 48.5% males) through sensitization campaigns (airings of jingles, posters, Public Address (PA) systems mounted on vehicles etc.)
